title: Expansion by point indicators
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f$ be a real-valued function on the subsets of an $n$-element set, and let $i$ be an element of that set. The Shapley value of $f$ at $i$ equals the sum, over all subsets $A$, of $f(A)$ times the Shapley value at $i$ of the indicator function of the singleton collection containing $A$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the subsets of an $n$-element set
$i$ is an element of the underlying $n$-element set
